basic_details.job_title: ZP Nagpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Medical Officer, Yoga Expert and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, Dietician
basic_details.short_information: National AYUSH Mission, Zilla Parishad, Nagpur (ZP Nagpur), Maharashtra, has invited applications for 3 posts in 3 roles. The posts include AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, Dietician. Applications are accepted online until 13 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only (RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking/UPI). Last date to pay the fee: 29 August 2024.

age_limit.age_details: 18 to 38 years for Open category, 18 to 43 years for reserved categories (as on 16 August 2024)

qualification.education_qualification: AYUSH Medical Officer (PG): MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa/Panchakarma); Yoga and Naturopathy Expert: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM registration/Paramedical Council registration OR M.Sc/B.Sc Yoga or MA Yoga; Dietician: B.Sc Food & Nutrition/Home Science OR PG Diploma in Dietetics after Science Graduation

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa/Panchakarma). Age limit: 18 to 38 years for Open category, 18 to 43 years for reserved categories. Pay: Rs. 60,000. Qualification required: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM registration/Paramedical Council registration; OR M.Sc/B.Sc Yoga or MA Yoga. Age limit: 18 to 38 years for Open category, 18 to 43 years for reserved categories. Pay: Rs. 28,000 Or 20,000. Qualification required: B.Sc Food & Nutrition/Home Science; OR PG Diploma in Dietetics after Science Graduation. Age limit: 18 to 38 years for Open category, 18 to 43 years for reserved categories. Pay: Rs. 20,000.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated honorarium: Rs. 60,000 (AYUSH Medical Officer PG), Rs. 28,000 or 20,000 (Yoga and Naturopathy Expert), Rs. 20,000 (Dietician)

how_to_apply: Visit www.nhm.zpnagpur.in, register your phone number and fill the online application (mandatory for all posts).
Scan and upload original documents while applying online.
Pay the Rs. 150/- fee online only (RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking/UPI).
Offline application is accepted at the office on office days during office hours.
Office: District Surgeon Office, Mankapur Stadium, District Hospital, Nagpur.
Last date for online and offline application: 13-11-2026 till 05:30 PM.
important_instructions: Merit list and recruitment notices will be published on www.nhm.zpnagpur.in and www.zpnagpur.maharashtra.gov.in Number of posts, place and honorarium may change No travelling or other allowance for attending the recruitment process Posting place cannot be changed on request False information found after selection makes the candidate liable to administrative action

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ZP Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 13 November 2026.

faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), 1 Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, 1 Dietician.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ZP Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.answer: Backward category: Rs. 150. Open category: Rs. 150.

faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 38 years for Open category, 18 to 43 years for reserved categories (as on 16 August 2024). Relaxation: Reserved categories 18 to 43 years, Retired government officers Age limit 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 60,000 for AYUSH Medical Officer (PG), Rs. 28,000 Or 20,000 for Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, Rs. 20,000 for Dietician.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: AYUSH Medical Officer (PG): MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa/Panchakarma); Yoga and Naturopathy Expert: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM registration/Paramedical Council registration OR M.Sc/B.Sc Yoga or MA Yoga; Dietician: B.Sc Food & Nutrition/Home Science OR PG Diploma in Dietetics after Science Graduation. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Physically and mentally fit for the post. No criminal case registered against the applicant. Registration certificate from the relevant council must be attached, otherwise ineligible.

faq.answer: Candidates working at more than one place. Employees retired from Class-3 and Class-4 posts (GR dated 17/12/2016). Candidates with more than two living children from 23/07/2020. Retired staff with departmental inquiry pending or proposed, or a criminal case.
